summary: Privileged access request: sampled streaming metrics & telemetry for customer-facing streaming sessions
description:
Issue summary: Security & Customer Success have requested time-limited privileged access to sampled streaming telemetry for a small set of customer streaming sessions. Purpose is to investigate a perceived quality regression in streamed partial responses and to validate whether KV cache snapshots and chunked frames correlate with dropped stream events.

Impact: Investigation may require access to raw telemetry that contains identifiers (session_id, request_id), partial token outputs (sampled streaming frames), and internal routing metadata. This data may include customer PII in freeform prompts; request must be minimized and redacted where possible.

Requestor: @customer-success (Escalation: Claire Royce) and Security (Escalation: Marco Silva).

Access requested: Read-only, time-bounded (48 hours) access to a curated sample set of streaming telemetry for up to 12 sessions across 3 customers (self_serve, dedicated, enterprise tiers) plus supporting routing logs and KV cache hashes. No bulk export.

Justification: Triaging recurring streaming disconnects and truncated outputs reported by customers across regions. Prior attempts using aggregated metrics and dashboards did not surface trace-level anomalies. Need trace + sampled frames to confirm whether the runtime is dropping frames during KV cache rebuild on mid-sequence rollovers.

Data scope & minimization: Only streaming frames flagged with error-code STREAM_PARTIAL_DROP or RTT spikes > 2000ms between frame send/ack. Strip or hash customer_user_id and full prompt text; retain redacted prompt first 128 characters only. Retain only minimal surrounding KV cache metadata (cache_key hash, cache_version).

Duration: 48-hour access window. Access to be provisioned via temporary role in the audit sandbox with full query logs and session recording of who accessed what.

Approvals requested: Security (Marco Silva), Legal/Privacy (Dana Liu), Head of SRE (Priya Nair).
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Identify affected customer session IDs from streaming disconnect dashboard (console -> Streaming > Drops).
2) Filter trace sampler to STREAM_PARTIAL_DROP and timeframe 2026-02-05 to 2026-02-09.
3) Pull sampled frames for each session. Note sequence numbers and KV cache version transitions.
4) Cross-check with routing decisions and model fallbacks logged by smart-router.
5) Observe any out-of-order frame emits or repeated resend attempts.

Expected behavior: Frames stream sequentially without duplication or silence gaps longer than configured keepalive. Actual: intermittent gaps and truncation observed in sampled traces.
investigation_notes:
- Initial SRE triage: latency spikes on serving-runtime between 2026-02-06T03:00-04:30 UTC in us-east-1 cluster rts-7; sampling rate for streams was 0.1% — increased to 5% for targeted customers.
- Hypothesis A: Inference engine KV cache hot-swap during model variant fallback causes a short-lived frame drop when cache is reset.
- Hypothesis B: Smart routing fallback to cheaper model variant initiates mid-stream and client-side reconnects cause perceived truncation.
- Observed: 7/12 sampled sessions show a cache_version bump coincident with 1-2 frame gaps. 3 sessions show routing fallback events within 150ms of the gap.
- Telemetry note: raw frame payloads include segments of user prompt; privacy redaction required before sharing.
- Audit: Access logs show no prior privileged access for these sessions. Will provision ephemeral role with just-in-time approval and integrated audit hooks.
- Related dashboards: Streaming Drops dashboard (console link), RTT heatmap (grafana link).
security_controls:
- Access window enforced via temporary IAM role (duration 48h).
- Queries only permitted through a restricted audit-proxy that redacts long prompt payloads and replaces user identifiers with salted hashes.
- All access will be recorded in audit logs; separate retention policy applied for exported samples (7 days).
- Non-production copies are not permitted.
- Explicit legal approval required for any sample containing unredacted PII.
approval_status: Pending - security approval received from Marco Silva on 2026-02-11; awaiting Legal (Dana Liu) and Head of SRE (Priya Nair).
resolution_plan:
If approvals granted: 1) SRE will create curated sample subset and run redaction pipeline (Elliot Chen + infra runbook). 2) Grant ephemeral role via IAM token tied to ticket ID INT-23641. 3) Provide access notes and query templates to requestors. 4) After 48h, automatically revoke role and perform audit verification.
If denied: provide aggregated diagnostic artifact and escalate to engineering for deeper runtime instrumentation.
Follow-ups: consider adding automated streaming-frame redaction and higher-fidelity sampling for priority customers.
